snippet.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator | National Championship Air Races: Launch Date Announce
snippet.description: On October 13th, 2026 Simmers can experience the thrills and adventure of air racing! Take to the skies over New Mexico with the release of the world's fastest motorsport: the National Championship Air Races. The sky is calling!
